You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ecfc8e0b3df568949ce82c9d46f78e55b2edf249 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Kuiper <alex@nightwhistler.net>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2013 09:39:55 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Title-page has page-num 0 again.

This is a fix for a bug introduced in
9dc75038618786d9e4ae64b84a8f6ce7cff2d075
---
 src/net/nightwhistler/pageturner/view/bookview/BookView.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/net/nightwhistler/pageturner/view/bookview/BookView.java b/src/net/nightwhistler/pageturner/view/bookview/BookView.java
index 44f6f8e..250d088 100644
--- a/src/net/nightwhistler/pageturner/view/bookview/BookView.java
+++ b/src/net/nightwhistler/pageturner/view/bookview/BookView.java
@@ -1080,7 +1080,7 @@ public class BookView extends ScrollView implements LinkTagHandler.LinkCallBack
 
         LOG.debug( "Looking for pageNumber for index=" + index + ", position=" + position );
 		
-		int pageNum = 0;
+		int pageNum = -1;
 		
 		List<List<Integer>> pageOffsets = spine.getPageOffsets();
 		
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by initializing the `pageNum` variable to 0 instead of -1. This change was necessary to correctly represent the absence of a valid page number, as page numbers typically start from 1. The previous initialization to 0 could lead to incorrect logic in the application, particularly when determining the page number for the title page, which should not be assigned a page number of 0.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by initializing the `pageNum` variable to 0 instead of -1. This change was necessary to correctly represent the absence of a valid page number, as page numbers typically start from 1. The previous initialization to 0 could lead to incorrect logic in the application, particularly when determining the page number for the title page, which should not be assigned a page number of 0.
